facts.text: Starting in fall 2026, John Carroll launches Onward, a platform providing a coordinated mentoring team, customized planning, and career launching for all students.

sources.title: Introducing Onward: A New Signature Platform that will Guide Your ...
sources.quote: Beginning in the fall of 2026, John Carroll will launch a new student success platform called Onward, a curated experience that will support every student's journey from their first day on campus through commencement and beyond.
